criteria.description: `requireAuth` must require the `Authorization` header to begin with `Bearer ` (literal string with trailing space); a header lacking this prefix returns HTTP 401 with body `{ "error": "Unauthorized" }` before token validation.
criteria.evidence: auth.ts line 17: `if (!authHeader || !authHeader.startsWith('Bearer '))` returns 401 JSON (lines 18-19). Tests passed (vitest verbose, 19/19): '✓ Auth middleware > rejects a request with no Bearer prefix' (sends Authorization: benchmark-token-2024, status 401) and '✓ GET /products > returns 401 without auth header' (no header, status 401).

criteria.description: `isValidToken` must be rewritten without `eval()`; must use pure string/array operations to extract digits, sum them as integers, and return `true` if and only if sum % 2 === 0.
criteria.evidence: `grep -r 'eval(' src/benchmark-backend/src/` returned no matches (exit code 1). auth.ts lines 8-12 use `.split('').filter(c => c >= '0' && c <= '9').reduce((sum, c) => sum + parseInt(c, 10), 0)` — pure string/array ops, no eval. Tests passed: '✓ Auth middleware > accepts any token whose digits sum to an even number' (Bearer custom-token-22, digits 2+2=4, status 200) and '✓ Auth middleware > rejects a token whose digits sum to an odd number' (Bearer invalid-111, digits 1+1+1=3, status 401).

criteria.description: A token containing special characters such as `"` or `)` must return HTTP 401, not HTTP 500.
criteria.evidence: Supertest run against live app: sent 'Authorization: Bearer tok"en)test-0' to GET /products — status 401 (not 500, not 200). auth.ts line 5 regex `!/^[a-zA-Z0-9\-_.]+$/` rejects characters '"' and ')'  → isValidToken returns false → requireAuth returns 401. Since eval() is absent, no 500 is possible. Custom test 'req3: special chars token returns 401 not 500' ✓ passed.

criteria.description: `requireAuth` must reject any token whose raw string length (after stripping 'Bearer ' prefix) exceeds 200 characters, returning HTTP 401 with body `{ "error": "Unauthorized" }`, checked before digit-sum validation.
criteria.evidence: auth.ts lines 22-25: `if (token.length > 200) { res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }); return; }` appears before isValidToken call at line 26. Supertest: 'Bearer ' + 'a'.repeat(201) → status 401 ✓; 'Bearer ' + '2'.repeat(200) (even digit sum, exactly 200 chars) → status 200 ✓ (boundary: 200 allowed, >200 rejected). Custom tests 'req4: 201-char token returns 401' ✓ and 'req4: 200-char token with even digit sum is accepted' ✓ both passed.

criteria.description: The `child_process` module must not be imported anywhere in `src/benchmark-backend/src/`. The `exec()` call must be removed from productController.ts.
criteria.evidence: `grep -r 'child_process' src/benchmark-backend/src/` returned no matches (exit code 1). `grep -r 'eval(' src/benchmark-backend/src/` returned no matches (exit code 1).
